summary: - **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)**: Removes the CSG-based CAD (ASSIMP) exporter from DDCAD because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private. This is a breaking removal of functionality needed to keep DD4hep building against current ROOT, and a replacement using only public ROOT interfaces is being worked on in #1682 to restore the export path.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663)**: Fixes `Geant4OutputAction` so that in multi-threaded mode ingested run parameters and file parameters actually end up in the output (fixes #1660), and repairs the endRun locking in `Geant4Output2LCIO` and `Geant4Output2ROOT`. This is an important correctness fix for MT DDsim jobs — previously metadata/run trees could be lost or duplicated per thread.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666)**: Adds a new `kUpstreamTrapezoid` shape type in `Mask_o1_v01_geo.cpp`/`OtherDetectorHelpers.h` to support non-cylindrically-symmetric FCC MDI synchrotron-radiation mask geometries, paired with k4geo #648. Enables more realistic MDI descriptions in FCC-ee.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#658](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658)**: Introduces the MuSIC_v3 muon-collider detector geometry: instrumented nozzles with three silicon Forward Tracker disks, reduced vertex barrel/endcap layers with corrected layer IDs, and use of the HCAL barrel as the magnetic flux return (yoke iron removed). A substantial new physics-facing detector variant for muon-collider studies.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)**: Hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy because cppyy was selecting the wrong overload (fixes #523). Impacts Python users of EDM4hep tracks by ensuring correct overload resolution in interpreted code.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98)**: Adapts k4ActsTracking to breaking ACTS API changes (propagator + grid-bin finder, [acts#6004](https://github.com/acts-project/acts/pull/6004)). Note that this makes k4ActsTracking@main incompatible with older tagged ACTS versions — downstream users pinning to released ACTS will need to bump.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104)**: Adds support for the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct introduced in [acts#6123](https://github.com/acts-project/acts/pull/6123) while retaining backward compatibility with released ACTS versions using the old pair-based API. Keeps material-map loading working across ACTS versions.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/102)**: Replaces deprecated ACTS material-binning APIs with `AxisSpec` for blueprint material binning ([acts#5738](https://github.com/acts-project/acts/pull/5738)). Another compatibility update to follow current ACTS.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54)**: Fixes PFO comparison to work with current EDM4hep after [EDM4hep#520](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/520). Restores correctness of Pandora PFA validation with the updated EDM.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)**: Adds `--evt-max` as a k4run alias for `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`, making the CLI closer to the underlying Gaudi property name. If both aliases are passed, argparse takes the last value; small but user-visible ergonomic improvement.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#427](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/427)**: Refactors the test components (ROOT-file producer, Marlin-wrapper producer, CellID metadata validation) to use functional algorithms and centralizes expected output collection definitions. Serves as an up-to-date reference example for users writing functional Gaudi algorithms.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1680](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1680)**: Replaces direct includes of the deprecated `RVersion.h` with `ROOT/RVersion.hxx` in DDCore and examples. Silences deprecation warnings against ROOT master and prepares DD4hep for the eventual removal of the old header.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)**: Maps detector volumes to their closest predefined ROOT color, part of the geometry visualization improvements in #616 (used together with root2gltf#15). Improves consistency and readability of geometry displays.

- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15)**: Shrinks children volumes that overlap their parents, reduces `numFaces` default to 1000, and improves transparency handling; also fixes a missing-field bug in `concatenateOutput.ts`. Produces cleaner, more distinguishable rendered geometries (visible e.g. in IDEA o1 v01 where envelopes and children are now rendered as distinct).

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97)**: Makes `--compactFile` required in `CLD_CKFTracking.py`, `runGNNTrackFinding.py`, and `test_visualize_acts_geo.py`. Replaces a cryptic Gaudi `PropertyProxy` `TypeError` with a clear argparse error when the compact file is omitted — a nice usability fix for tracking users.

- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#284](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/284)**: Moves `find_package(boost_timer/unit_test_framework)` inside the `BUILD_TESTING` block in `RecCaloCommon`. Configuring with `-DBUILD_TESTING=OFF` no longer requires those Boost components — useful for slimmer downstream builds.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386)**: Extends the tracking-validation option to the IDEA full-sim digitization/reconstruction steering and exposes `--addTruthTracks`/`--runTrkValidation` through the IDEA and ALLEGRO ctest wrappers. Broadens tracking-validation coverage for FCC-ee physics studies.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCeePhysicsStudies#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61)**: Adds updated FSR beam parameters for the FCC-ee lattice (still GHC-based since LCC values above the Z pole are not yet available; IP parameters are similar). Small but relevant input update for physics-performance studies.
